szenen.text: The US just added 165,000 jobs in October. Economists expected about 60,000.
Unemployment fell to 4.1%. Wages rose 0.4% in one month. September was revised up to 60,000 jobs.
Strong hiring and faster wages give the Fed less reason to wait. Its next rate decision comes on December 9.
